messages:
Leah (CSM): Aurora renewal update: procurement insists on NET60 and wants a 60/40 split (PO/CC). They also requested our vendor code + a brief services appendix for onboarding. Can we accept without changing price?
Omar (AE): They want to keep existing pricing. ARR is $75k. Finance might want higher upfront. Tagging Credit Ops and Billing.
June (Aurora): Procurement policy is strict — PO-first preferred. We can capture 40% on card at signature. Will send PO draft referencing Master Agreement v2.
Priya (Billing): NET60 where >50% on PO triggers Credit Ops approval. Need vendor code, remit-to address, Tax ID, and PO sample. For split flow: capture 40% CC -> invoice 60% PO NET60.
Procurement Bot: "Policy: NET60 with >50% PO requires Credit Ops approval and a signed services appendix listing acceptance criteria."
Leah (CSM): @Credit Ops please advise on acceptability for ARR band under $100k with 60/40 split. Also looping Legal Ops for appendix language.
Credit Ops: For <$100k ARR, 40% upfront is borderline. Recommend 50% CC to auto-approve. If customer won't adjust, we'll need a brief credit memo and CFO sign-off.
Omar (AE): I'll propose 50/50 to procurement and offer 15mo pro-rate as sweetener. June, can you try to nudge them?
June (Aurora): I'll ask procurement if 50/50 is possible. They prefer 60/40 but will check. PO draft ETA tomorrow; vendor code will be included.
Legal Ops: We'll draft a 1-page services appendix (onboarding scope + acceptance checklist). Signature options: DocuSign amendment or PO referencing Master + countersigned PDF. If PO contains NET60 confirm Credit Ops approval on thread before invoicing.
Onboarding Eng: We'll prepare kickoff plan but will not schedule live sessions until the upfront CC clears. Can start docs and account prep earlier.
Priya (Billing): If 50/50 accepted flow is: capture 50% CC -> invoice 50% PO NET60 with PO#. Need vendor code header e.g. `VendorCode: RWINF-77`. I'll standby to generate invoice once PO/approval in thread.
Leah (CSM): Action items: Omar to propose 50/50 + 15mo proration; June to share PO draft & vendor code; Legal Ops to post appendix; Credit Ops to advise on memo if procurement holds at 60/40. Please react with :white_check_mark: once done.
Omar (AE): Reached out to procurement now, looping June and Credit Ops.
June (Aurora): Got it. Will update when procurement replies.
Leah (CSM): Thanks all — I'll close once PO or DocuSign + CC auth screenshot appears here.
